label: disable_persistent_config setting (Sync Gateway)
type: the boolean startup flag (config file or command line) that switches Sync Gateway from persistent/bootstrap configuration back to sgw:legacy-pre-3-config. Default false. Documented since Sync Gateway 2.x.
note: The gate between the two configuration eras - every legacy-vs-persistent behavioural difference in this batch (collections support, REST persistence, load-balancer compatibility) is stated relative to this one flag.
